title: Guardian Controlled Mint Authorization — Final

guardian_details.governance_model: Multi-signature safe requiring guardian approval before any wallet action
guardian_details.authorization_scope: Exactly one controlled proof mint via OINIOModelRegistry.registerModel()

pre_approval_required: Metadata URI must be defined (IPFS or on-chain URI)
Stake amount must be defined (> 0 OINIO)
Operator wallet must have sufficient OINIO balance for stake + gas
Operator wallet must have 0G tokens for gas on chain 16661
Guardian must confirm contract source matches deployed bytecode (OINIOModelRegistry at 0x67aD7169184581f23D1E10B39d4eb4e98293E87a)
execution_sequence: 1. approve(OINIO_TOKEN, registry, stakeAmount) — operator wallet signs
2. registerModel(name, metadataURI, stakeAmount) — operator wallet signs
3. Verify ModelRegistered event on 0G Aristotle Mainnet explorer
4. Seal execution receipt with tx hash, block number, model ID

risk_acknowledgments: OINIO tokens will be transferred from operator wallet to registry contract permanently (staked)
Transaction is irreversible on 0G Aristotle Mainnet
Gas costs paid in 0G native tokens
registerModel uses transferFrom which requires prior approval
Model ID is auto-incremented by registry contract
next_safe_step: Phase 13 human decisions receipt: define recipient_address, metadata_uri, and stake_amount_oinio. No wallet action until Phase 13 final pre-execution authorization is sealed.
